capabilities: Loops one or more named A–B sections, with an optional pause between repeats
Changes playback speed from 0.5× to 1.5× without changing pitch
Shifts pitch by semitones or cents, saved per audio file
Reads sections and a starting section from a loops code block in a note
Provides commands for loop, section and pitch actions
extras: Pitch shifting reads the whole file into memory on desktop the first time it is changed; the plugin never writes to notes, and a settings button forgets all saved sections.
problem: Practising a piece from an audio file in Obsidian means seeking by hand, with no way to loop a passage, slow it down, or change key.

relations.evidence: e.g. as written by trad-split under each embed

summary: Audio player for practising music that loops named A–B sections, changes speed with pitch preserved, and shifts pitch independently.
